description: This file defines a template class TlsEnabled for managing TLS configuration in WebSocket connections, including setting certificates, keys, CA files, and initializing SSL contexts with proper verification and cipher options.

classes.name: TlsEnabled
classes.description: A template class providing TLS setup and configuration for WebSocket clients, including certificate management and SSL context initialization.

methods.name: setCertFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the TLS certificate.

methods.name: setKeyFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the private key.

methods.name: setCAFileNames
methods.description: Sets the list of CA certificate filenames.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes TLS handling by setting the TLS init handler.

methods.name: setAuthenticationState
methods.description: Determines and sets the authentication success based on connection error codes.

methods.name: onTlsInit
methods.description: Creates and configures the SSL context for a TLS connection.

methods.name: loadCertificateAuthorities
methods.description: Loads CA certificates into the SSL context, or defaults if none specified.
